items.title: MACOM Announces Ann Arbor Capacity Expansion

paragraphs.text: MACOM expects to begin volume production of its 200G/lane EML driver at the Ann Arbor fab by Q4 2026.
The company plans to expand its capacity at the Ann Arbor facility over the next year.
